question.description: Exact unpadded Ask input persisted for display. CORE searches the complete value unchanged as one literal continuous source phrase; it does not perform natural-question understanding, token OR, rewriting, or semantic expansion.

info.description: Implementation-bound local CORE HTTP surface. It excludes UI assets, backup restore, SSE, accounts, remote authentication, Agent, vector, and other LATER capabilities.

post.description: Creates one durable keyword/continuous-phrase-driven grounded generation attempt. Before any model call, the complete question value is passed unchanged to the same scoped literal continuous-phrase FTS query used by Search. A fact-related natural question whose full text is not contiguous in a source normally returns a controlled NO_CONTEXT refusal; CORE does not claim natural-language retrieval.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON; unknown, duplicate, mis-cased, or trailing fields are rejected. The question is a literal source phrase, despite the stable field name.

post.x-mindweaver-optimistic-control: expectedRevision in strict JSON body; ETag and If-Match are unsupported

post.description: Accept one in-process backup Create. The destination is never overwritten and is never returned. The backup package contains plaintext SQLite and blob files and relies on account, media access-control, and disk-encryption policy for confidentiality. An already existing valid backup is reported as needs_attention and is never claimed as a fresh snapshot. Recovery restore and verify operations are intentionally absent from the live API.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON; duplicate, unknown, mis-cased, trailing, relative, remote, cloud, hot-plug, reparse, and active-Vault-overlap destinations are rejected.

202.description: Backup creation was accepted or the same in-process idempotent operation was replayed. Completion is read through the status operation.

post.summary: Create one no-replace, integrity-verifiable local backup
post.x-mindweaver-retry-safety: bounded process-memory Idempotency-Key commitment plus exact destination; history exhaustion fails closed, and an existing valid target is never claimed as a fresh backup
